chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 471 – Han Li’s Suspicious Victory: The Soul-Crying Beast
chapter_meta_description: Han Li abandons the woman he just saved to force a deal, finally acquiring the Crying Soul Beast. But why was Yuan Yao so eager to give it up? A masterclass in Mortal Stream negotiation.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 471: The Art of the Cold Deal
og_description: Han Li plays a dangerous game of social manipulation to win a powerful spirit beast. The cost: a beautiful woman’s favor and a lingering question of who got the better end of the bargain.
twitter_title: RMJI 471: Han Li plays 4D chess with a grateful beauty
twitter_description: Han Li forces Yuan Yao to beg for protection, winning a rare spirit beast. But was it a victory or a setup? A masterclass in cold negotiation.

lore_anchors.definition: A secret fire-thunder of the demonic sect Qing Yang Gate, known for its immense power rivaling a Nascent Soul cultivator's Primordial Yang Fire.
A special bead used to control and bind a Crying Soul Beast; it must be refined like a magic treasure to establish a permanent connection.
A rare spirit beast with a unique ability to absorb souls and dissolve ghostly energy, making it a powerful counter against Yin and ghost-type cultivators.
The pure Yang essence fire of a Nascent Soul cultivator, representing a high-level, concentrated form of destructive power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li walk away after saving Yuan Yao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He uses a classic "desperate seller" negotiation tactic—creating a scarcity of his own protection to force her to offer a reward, he doesn't just give things away for free.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li so suspicious of the deal at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yuan Yao agreed to give up the rare Crying Soul Beast far too quickly and with a hint of glee, which goes against all of Han Li's paranoid survival instincts.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a ‘Charm Technique’ in this context?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a deliberate social and combat skill, not genuine emotion; Yuan Yao uses her beauty and cultivation to try and cloud Han Li's judgment, a standard tool in the xianxia world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the Crying Soul Beast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a natural counter to ghost-type cultivators; Han Li specifically wants it as a strategic asset to defend himself from the Profound Bone Saint, a powerful ghost entity.
